entities.summary: Michael Dal Colle is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is currently a Free Agent. He last played for HC Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Dal Colle was selected by the New York Islanders in the first round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft. Dal Colle was born in Richmond Hill, Ontario, but grew up in Vaughan, Ontario.
